title: fix(console): Set as Default over a shipped default view leaves one default view
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-tesla"} -->
_Requested by **Tesla** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6Jao?thread=cmsg_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6JaoViN2PNU4fvWWn73u9xxXAL)_

Fixes #33098

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：在「管理视图」里把一个视图设为默认时，如果原来的默认视图是包里自带的（比如 showcase 的 All Tasks），现在会先把它的默认标记写进该包的定制包（`com.example.showcase.custom`），成功后才把新视图设为默认；两步改为依次执行，前一步被拒就停下并提示原因。
- 为什么改：之前两步同时发出，清除包内视图默认标记那一步被服务端拒绝（只读包的条目不允许不带包名写入），新默认却照样写进去了，结果对象上出现两个默认视图，默认路由也跟着变了。
- 风险与回滚：改动只在控制台的视图写入层：包内自带视图的置顶、改名、默认标记现在都写进它的定制包（首次使用时由服务端现有的 ensure 接口创建该定制包）；用户自建视图、可写包里的视图写法不变。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`ui/packages/data-objectstack/src/index.ts` 新增的 `viewCustomizationHome` 与 `updateView` 的写入分支；`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/objectViewViewCrud.tsx` 的 `handleSetDefaultView` 循环。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/data-objectstack/src/updateView.draft.test.ts packages/app-shell/src/views/ObjectView.viewWriteRefusal-11583.test.tsx`，预期全绿。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。
- 席位意见：已按 pm-dispatch 审核清单核对：随包发布的视图改为写入该包的定制包（服务端拒绝信息里要求的做法），设默认时先逐个清除旧默认、最后再设新默认，被拒就停下并说明原因，不会再出现两个默认；席位要求补测了第二次写入（切回、置顶），都写入定制包并成功。没有服务端改动。可落地。

## What changes

**The write lands where the server says it must (`@object-ui/data-objectstack`).** `updateView`'s published branch now asks one new private helper, `viewCustomizationHome`, where the write goes:

- The view read carries no `_packageId`: no package ships it, written package-less as before.
- `GET /packages/BASE` answers `writable: false`: the view ships in a read-only package. The write goes into the pair the ensure door answers (`POST /packages/BASE/ensure-customization`, ADR-0146 D3), as `PUT /meta/view/NAME?package=PAIR`, with the whole merged document and `overrides: { package: BASE, basedOn }` (D2). `basedOn` is the declaration the read already carries when the view is a customization in the pair, else the package's served `manifest.version`, the version Studio's Customize declares.
- Any other answer of `writable` (a writable package, or none served): written package-less as before.
- A base with no version, a refused package read or a refused ensure door: the error reaches the caller and nothing is written.

The pair's id is never spelled in the console: it is the ensure door's answer.

**Set as Default applies its writes one at a time (`@object-ui/app-shell`).** `handleSetDefaultView` walks `setDefaultViewPatches` in order (every clear first, the set last) and awaits each write before the next, through the same `dispatchViewPatches` relay. The first refusal stops the run and reaches the existing `toast.error` with the door's message. So a refused clear no longer leaves the new default written beside the old one. The order of `setDefaultViewPatches` is unchanged; its docblock now says the order is load-bearing.

**Changeset:** `.changeset/33098-set-default-shipped-view.md`, `@object-ui/app-shell` and `@object-ui/data-objectstack` patch, with both declaration lines.

No server change and no `packages/spec` change.

## Tests

- `data-objectstack/src/updateView.draft.test.ts`, a new top-level describe in the existing `updateView` harness (its `makeDS` takes an optional `packages` double):
  - a shipped default's clear is ONE `saveItem` naming the ensure door's pair (`{ packageId: PAIR }`), carrying `overrides: { package: BASE, basedOn: '0.1.0' }`, `isDefault: false` and the whole document;
  - a view already customized keeps its declared `basedOn` (`0.1.0` while the package serves `0.2.0`);
  - a pin (`isPinned`) of a shipped view goes through the same seam;
  - a refused ensure door rejects with that refusal and writes nothing;
  - a base that records no version is refused before the ensure door is asked, and nothing is written;
  - CONTROL: a view no package ships is written with the three arguments it always had, no package door asked;
  - CONTROL: a view a writable package ships is written package-less, no pair ensured.
- `app-shell/src/views/ObjectView.viewWriteRefusal-11583.test.tsx`, a new top-level describe in the existing mounted refusal harness (the real `ObjectView`):
  - the previous default is a shipped view whose clear is refused: the clear is asked, the new default's `{ isDefault: true }` is never issued, `updateView` is called once, one `toast.error` carries the refusal, `toast.success` is never called;
  - the set is issued only once the clear has landed (a held clear: one call in flight, then both, in order);
  - CONTROL: both views user-owned, both writes land and nothing is raised.

## Acceptance notes

- **Which door admits the unset, measured on a booted showcase** (`pnpm dev -- --fresh`, objectstack `84c66d36`, admin): `PUT /api/v1/meta/view/showcase_task.default` with `isDefault: false` and no package answers `403 NOT_OVERRIDABLE`, "save it into 'com.example.showcase.custom' (?package=com.example.showcase.custom), declaring overrides: { package: 'com.example.showcase', basedOn }". The same PUT with `?package=com.example.showcase.custom` before the pair exists answers `422 WRITABLE_PACKAGE_REQUIRED`. `POST /api/v1/packages/com.example.showcase/ensure-customization` answers `201` with `packageId: com.example.showcase.custom`. The PUT into the pair with the declaration then answers `200` ("Saved customization overlay … package=com.example.showcase.custom, state=active"), and `GET /api/v1/meta/view?object=showcase_task` serves `showcase_task.default` with `isDefault: false` and the declaration. The same PUT into the pair without `overrides` answers `403 NOT_OVERRIDABLE` (D2). The served item keeps `_packageId: com.example.showcase` after the override, so a second edit routes the same way.
- **The other row-state writes the card suspected.** Pin (`handlePinView`) and rename (`handleRenameView`) both write through `updateView`, so both are routed by the same seam; the pin is pinned. A drag-reorder writes no view (it is the user's own tab order), so `sortOrder` is not affected.
- **One partial outcome is left.** If the clear lands and the set is then refused, the object is left with no default view (the shipped fallback applies) and the refusal is said. Both writes need the same permission, so this needs a refusal specific to the new view. Not measured on a live server.
- **Not changed:** `updateView`'s draft branch (a shipped view with a pending draft) writes the draft back as it did. A view a writable package ships is written package-less as it was; whether that write should name the package was not measured and is outside this card.
- **Ruling hits in the surface** (`ruling|Ruling-ref|maintainer|⛔`): none inside the edited regions. The file-level hits (`objectViewTabs.ts`, a "ruling" comment on personal scope; `objectViewViewCrud.tsx`, a ⛔ about the retired overlay write; `data-objectstack/src/index.ts`, 46 hits) sit outside the hunks and are untouched.

## Verification

Every reading below is on head `63ebe5e6` (objectstack `main` `47f6c939` merged once) unless it says otherwise. The showcase measurements and the browser run were taken on the branch before that merge; the merge brought in docs only.

<details><summary>Browser run on the rebuilt console (showcase, admin)</summary>

A published user view `showcase_task.qa_x` was created over the API, then Tasks → view switcher → Manage views → `manage-views-default-showcase_task.qa_x`. The writes the page sent, in order:

```text
POST /api/v1/packages/com.example.showcase/ensure-customization -> 201
PUT /api/v1/meta/view/showcase_task.default?package=com.example.showcase.custom -> 200
PUT /api/v1/meta/view/showcase_task.qa_x -> 200
```

No toast. `GET /api/v1/meta/view?object=showcase_task` then lists one list-kind default: `showcase_task.qa_x`.
</details>

<details><summary>Ablations (each through scripts/ablation-replace.mjs, restored to HEAD and proved by blob hash)</summary>

- Handler: the one-at-a-time loop replaced by the former `Promise.all` over the whole list. `ObjectView.viewWriteRefusal-11583.test.tsx`: 2 failed, 12 passed. Red: the refused-clear pin ("expected vi.fn() to not be called with arguments [crm_deal, …]") and the ordering pin. Green: the CONTROL and every older case.
- Adapter: `const home = await this.viewCustomizationHome(current, viewName)` replaced by `const home = null`. `updateView.draft.test.ts`: 5 failed, 10 passed. Red: the five routing pins. Green: both CONTROLs and every older case.

Both suites import the source (`./ObjectView`, `./index`), so no dist was involved.
</details>

<details><summary>Tests and type-check</summary>

- `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/data-objectstack/src/updateView.draft.test.ts packages/app-shell/src/views/ObjectView.viewWriteRefusal-11583.test.tsx packages/app-shell/src/views/writeRefusalCensus-11583.test.ts packages/app-shell/src/views/ObjectView.unboundAdapterCall.test.ts packages/app-shell/src/views/ObjectView.setDefaultViewIdentity.test.tsx`: Test Files 5 passed (5), Tests 63 passed (63).
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/data-objectstack run type-check` and `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell run type-check` (both `tsc --noEmit` and `tsconfig.test.json`): exit 0.
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack`: 38 commands, each run with stdin closed, all exit 0, `node scripts/check-sdui-manifest.mjs` included. `--ran` reconciliation: "38 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 38 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED". The first pass on the head before `63ebe5e6` had `check:test-source-alias` red, asking for a module-top `@objectstack/lint` import in the mounted harness; `63ebe5e6` adds it.
- CI families are read from this PR's check-runs, not re-run locally.
</details>
